title: Easy Shampoo Hair Colour - Natural Brown 4

details.description:
Indica 10-Minute Hair Color Shampoo offers a revolutionary way to color your hair quickly and effectively, all from the comfort of your home. Designed for convenience and fast results, this easy-to-use DIY sachet-based hair color shampoo delivers a rich, long-lasting natural brown shade in just 10 minutes. Each pack includes a perfectly portioned 12.5g colourant and 12.5ml developer, making it ideal for single use with no wastage or guesswork. Whether you're touching up roots or doing a full application, this product ensures hassle-free coverage and consistent color performance.
Formulated without ammonia, the Indica 10-Minute Hair Colour Shampoo is gentle on the scalp and hair, minimising irritation and exposure to harsh chemicals. It is enriched with the natural goodness of five time-tested herbal extracts—Amla, Hibiscus, Henna, Bhringraj, and Fenugreek. These ingredients not only support healthy hair coloring but also nourish and strengthen the hair strands, adding natural shine and softness. The blend helps improve hair texture while preserving its natural moisture and vitality.
This pack comes with a special offer—Buy 3 and Get 1 Free—making it a cost-effective solution for regular hair coloring needs. The formulation is suitable for both men and women and works effectively on greys, providing uniform and vibrant coverage from root to tip. Whether you're a first-time user or a regular colorer, Indica’s 10-Minute Hair Color Shampoo makes the entire experience quick, mess-free, and salon-like at home.
details.usageInstructions: Put on gloves. Squeeze out the entire shampoo hair colour on hands. Massage it thoroughly on the hair. Rinse hair after 10 minutes.

details.description: Indica Creme colour is an Ammonia-Free hair colour enriched with the goodness of Walnuts and Silk protein. This creme-based hair colour gives 100% grey coverage in just 10 minutes of application. It locks the colour for long-lasting and vibrant results. The DIY 10 minutes hair colour is easy to apply at home. The most compatible long-lasting hair colour with your scalp is easy to apply at home. A very convenient usage that requires no hassle. Just empty the sachets, mix the contents and apply on the hair. The 10 minutes Creme hair colour comes in 3 shades: Natural Black, Natural Brown and Burgundy. This pack contains Colourant and Developer.
details.usageInstructions:
Put on hand gloves. Apply on dry hair.
Cut the Indica Hair Color sachet and squeeze out the entire quantity of colourant and developer in a non-metallic bowl.
Mix the contents thoroughly until the colour changes.
Massage the head simply (2-3 minutes) till all the visible greys are covered.
Leave the colour on the hair for 10 minutes.
Rinse hair thoroughly with water.
Apply the Indica Natural & Nourish Conditioner evenly to the hair, massage gently & leave in for 2 minutes.
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
Take a small quantity of Indica Natural & Nourish Smoothening Hair Serum in your palm, spread it onto damp or towel-dried hair and apply evenly.
Style as desired.

title: Xpress Creme Hair Colour - Natural Black 1

details.description:
Experience salon-like hair colour at home with Indica Xpress Crème Hair Color in Natural Black. Designed for convenience and performance, this advanced crème-based formula works in just 10 minutes to deliver 100% grey coverage with a rich satin shine finish.
Enriched with a triple oil blend of Onion Oil, Coconut Oil, and Argan Oil, it nourishes hair deeply while colouring, leaving it smooth, soft, and conditioned. The no-ammonia formula ensures a gentle colouring experience while maintaining hair health.
The colour lasts up to 32 washes*, giving you long-lasting results with a natural look. Complete with a conditioner and an easy application process, this kit is ideal for quick, effective, and hassle-free hair colouring at home.
details.usageInstructions:
Recommendation:
Apply color on washed and
completely dried hair
Wait for at least 2 months if
your hair has been colored with henna or hair color containing metallic salts
Skin Hypersensitivity Test:
This preparation may cause
serious inflammation of the skin in some cases, so a preliminary test should
always be carried out to determine whether or not special sensitivity exists
To make the test, cleanse a small
area of skin behind the ear or upon the inner surface of the forearm, using
either soap and water or alcohol
Apply a small quantity of the
hair dye as prepared for use to the area and allow it to dry
After 48 hours, wash the area
gently with soap and water
If no irritation or inflammation
is apparent, it may be assumed that no hypersensitivity to the dye exists
The test should, however, be
carried out before each and every application
This preparation should on no
account be used for dyeing eyebrows or eyelashes, as severe inflammation of the
eye or even blindness may result
Caution:

according to the accompanying direction should first be made

the eye or even blindness
Caution and skin hypersensitivity
test in the local language are given in the leaflet
